evidence.criterion: Tall pleated side and thick turn meet narrow floor; new six low short pieces must demonstrate a different body scale and crossover route, not merely a different color.
Existing high concave lip contains an interior floor. New broken shell must show separate standing/low sections with bare floor crossing the former body, not another bowl.
Existing coarse long fragment and staggered side ends are clearly layered. New crossed groups must read as thick joined heads plus short tails and branched route, not three repeated beams.
Existing large turned skin ends beside a broad low sheet. New smaller half rolls must form visible interrupted arc and decreasing ends, not duplicate the same large foreground piece.

limitations: These are actual historical normal-FOV frames, not current B03 images.
Different world positions/source versions prevent strict same-camera pixel comparison.
No new world passes until its normal views and routes are actually observed.
